'''Brian Buchanan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Birmingham Grand Slam]] on 28 October 2000 with weird mains deck that only starts Dagobah system, according to Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1410">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-31-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1410/ birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 31 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-31-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1410/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
